submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Draw independent NE running phase 7 using input1 as EDIT TARGET; change ONLY pose of hips/knees/ankles/legs and tiny natural head bob. Preserve exact head pixel size, fixed camera and canvas, back three-quarter facing upper-right. Just before LEFT touchdown: starting from target LEFT stance, lift the LEFT heel only 18 pixels off its ground position, extend LEFT knee slightly so leading lower leg prepares for landing, toe aimed upper-right. RIGHT trailing leg stays clearly airborne with folded knee and sole visible. Head/pelvis rise only 10 pixels, not resizing. Keep BOTH shoe heel-to-toe axes along upper-right travel, no toe-out V-shaped feet, knees track over toes. Preserve correct anatomical RIGHT hand FIVE-card fan on screen right, LEFT hand bronze bell on screen left, shoulder and wrist chain unchanged. Only five cards, no sixth sliver. Keep arms and props almost identical except small natural recoil; NEVER exchange hand props. Keep face/hair/pony crown, waist knot, rich painted red-gold costume and near ground y920 at1024, rootx512. Input2identity,3NEidleorientation,4styleonly. Native square>=1024 RGBA actual transparency. No floor shadow glow particles labels. Single real new frame; no copied pose or bitmap repositioning.
